name: long_scroll
description: Tall long-image / scroll storytelling: chapter rhythm, sticky thesis, mobile width
when_to_use: 长图 / long image / 长截图 / scroll story / 条漫式长图 / H5 long page visual — single tall continuous board (not multi artboard website, not short poster)
prompt_negative: When the user asks for a long image, prefer one tall scroll board over a short square poster or a multi-artboard website. Prefer chapter titles with breathing room. Simple separators may stay vector; complex chapter scenes that look crude as shapes should use images.

zh-CN.description: 竖向长图叙事：章节节奏、主张复现、移动宽度
